lines: Hey, you don't understand a thing
So-and-so is absorbed in the world in their hands, learning how to keep a monster
To be chosen, they'd sell their tongue; for every betrayal, they dig a grave
That grinning head of theirs is beyond help — nothing but lukewarm words come out
If I can say bye-bye to faces I won't remember, I could become an asura too
Running — escape, escape, escape — still a Buddha
Leaping — step, step, step — as you command
Understand, understand — boldly devouring even King Enma himself
Deceiving — sneak, sneak, sneak — in the storm
Bouncing — skip, skip, skip — oh, sure, whatever
Understand, understand — might as well suck the marrow clean from the bone
Hey, you don't understand a thing
We burn the stains of our days in the trees and warm ourselves together
His four limbs, having slandered duty, scatter to pieces
Without even knowing it, they worship meaning as aesthetics
I was content with an arbitrary will like fake bait
To a full course of delightful sermonizing, I wore a surface of a face and played the favorite
Rather than dance with that worthless monk, I'd join hands with the devil
Running — escape, escape, escape — still a Buddha
Leaping — step, step, step — as you command
Understand, understand — locked on to the very end of the Avici hell
Deceiving — sneak, sneak, sneak — in the storm
Bouncing — skip, skip, skip — oh, sure, whatever
Understand, understand — save your sleep-talk for the other world
Running — escape, escape, escape — still a Buddha
Leaping — step, step, step — as you command
Understand, understand — boldly devouring even King Enma himself
Deceiving — sneak, sneak, sneak — in the storm
Bouncing — skip, skip, skip — oh, sure, whatever
Understand, understand — might as well suck the marrow clean from the bone
Hey, screaming and wailing, refusing to bow your head
